essence: The merit of the gift lasts for as many hundreds of years as there are hairs on a girl.
The prescribed gift should be fashioned from a thousand gold units or from a niṣka or more.
One should make a well-marked bull using a measure of one hundred and eight.
The ear of the bull should be made with ruby and the hump with hessonite.
The learned one should have the bull's body covered with strings of bells and garlands.
